reason: Honestly the pet and streaks are what got me to look, and I'd install the free demo just to play with it. But putting my name on a list for a paid plan where an AI moves my real money, with no broker named and no price, is a step I'm not taking yet.
objection: I don't trust an AI with my money. Limits and a kill switch sound nice, but I'd have to see it not do something dumb with demo money for a few months, and I'd need to know which licensed broker actually holds my cash.
would_change_my_mind: A named, licensed broker holding the money, plus a couple of months of my own demo record showing the agent stayed inside my limits and didn't do anything I'd regret.
